jobs.title: Flex Level II Officer Alvarado, TX
jobs.description:
Flex Level II Officer Alvarado, TX


Level II Flex Officer


Shift: Open Availability


Pay Rate: $17.00 HR 30-32 HR


Job Overview


We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Security Officer to safeguard our premises, personnel, and assets. The ideal candidate will possess strong observational skills, a commitment to safety, and the ability to respond effectively to emergencies. This role involves patrolling assigned areas, monitoring surveillance systems, and ensuring compliance with security protocols. Prior experience in law enforcement, military, or security services is highly valued. The Security Officer will play a critical role in maintaining a secure environment through proactive security measures and excellent customer service.


Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly to alarms, incidents, and emergencies following established procedures
  • Write detailed incident reports accurately and promptly for any security-related events
  • Operate surveillance equipment such as CCTV cameras and alarm systems to ensure continuous monitoring of premises
  • Manage access control by verifying identities and issuing passes to authorized personnel
  • Perform manual handling tasks including heavy lifting when necessary for security operations or equipment setup
  • Enforce security regulations and policies while maintaining a professional demeanor at all times
  • Assist in performing background checks on visitors or contractors as required
  • Provide first aid and CPR in emergency situations, utilizing AED operation when needed
  • De-escalate conflicts through conflict management techniques and conflict de-escalation skills
  • Conduct thorough patrolling of the property to identify potential hazards or safety issues
  • Perform emergency response procedures including fire safety protocols, AED use, and incident containment
  • Maintain clear communication with law enforcement or emergency services during incidents when appropriate


Experience

  • Prior experience in law enforcement, military service, or private security is preferred but not mandatory; relevant experience in surveillance, incident report writing, or physical security is advantageous
  • Training in first aid, CPR, AED operations
  • Operation, and compliance with security regulations is beneficial
  • Demonstrated ability to handle conflict de-escalation and conflict management situations effectively
  • Managing emergency response procedures will be considered a plus

This Security Officer role offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where safety and professionalism are paramount. Candidates must be committed to upholding the highest standards of security while providing excellent customer service.


Minimum Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, candidates must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or experience required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Minimum high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Current or prior military experience, or college education in the security field desirable.
  • Minimum 1-3 years of professional-level work experience preferred.
  • Must possess a valid registration/permit/license required by the state in which the employee is employed. As a condition of employment, employee must successfully complete a background investigation and a post-offer/pre-employment drug/alcohol test where required by the Company or client. Some clients require additional background screening, testing, and procedures.


Why St. Moritz?

Are you looking for a rewarding career in the security industry? Join St. Moritz Security Services, Inc., a well -established company with over 43 years in the industry.

No security program can be successfully implemented without quality people to execute the program.


The ST. MORITZ DIFFERENCE is our PEOPLE.

From the first level security officer to the CEO, St. Moritz is committed from the top down to provide the highest level of service possible.

jobs.title: Event Security Officers – Level II & Level III
jobs.description:
We are seeking professional, dependable, and experienced security officers to support event operations alongside event staff, venue security, local law enforcement.

Positions Available

  • Level II Non-Commissioned Security Officers
  • Level III Commissioned Security Officers

Level II Non-Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level II Officers will provide professional, uniformed security support throughout the event. Officers will primarily be assigned to access-control, observation, guest-flow, and security-presence posts.

Responsibilities

  • Staff assigned security posts, including entrances, interior doorways, stairwells, corridors, registration areas, and other designated locations.
  • Maintain a professional and visible security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for unauthorized access, disturbances, suspicious activity, safety concerns, or violations of event policies.
  • Assist with orderly guest movement and crowd flow.
  • Provide basic directions and assistance to guests when appropriate.
  • Report security incidents or concerns through the established chain of command.
  • Assist event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement personnel as directed.
  • Respond appropriately to disturbances, safety concerns, or medical incidents until relieved by emergency personnel.
  • Remain at your assigned post unless properly relieved or directed otherwise.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Important: Event personnel, not Level II officers, will have primary responsibility for validating invitations and checking guest identification.

Level II Requirements

  • Current Texas DPS Non-Commissioned Security Officer (Level II) license, or higher applicable Texas security license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation with RKSMS through the Texas Online Private Security system prior to the event.
  • Must have completed all required Texas training and licensing requirements.
  • Level II officers will not carry firearms while performing security duties.
  • Professional appearance and conduct.
  • Strong communication and situational-awareness skills.
  • Ability to remain standing and attentive for extended periods.

Level III Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level III Officers will provide armed security coverage at strategically designated locations throughout the event. Officers will supplement Level II personnel and support areas requiring an elevated security presence and rapid-response capability.

Responsibilities

  • Staff designated armed-security posts at higher-risk or strategically important locations.
  • Maintain a professional and highly visible armed-security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for threats, disturbances, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and safety concerns.
  • Provide immediate security response when directed by event leadership.
  • Assist with de-escalation and management of security incidents within the officer's authority and training.
  • Coordinate with event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement when necessary.
  • Maintain strict firearms safety, weapons-retention, and use-of-force discipline.
  • Remain at the assigned post unless properly relieved or redirected.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Level III Requirements

  • Current and active Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer (Level III) license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation prior to the event.
  • Completion of required Level III training, testing, and firearms qualification.
  • Must meet all applicable Texas DPS firearms requirements.
  • Must be qualified with the type/category of firearm authorized for use at the event.
  • Strong situational awareness, communication, and professional judgment.
  • Ability to remain attentive and professional in a large, high-profile event environment.

Ideal Candidates

We are looking for security professionals who are:

  • Licensed and in good standing with Texas DPS.
  • Reliable and punctual.
  • Professional and customer-service oriented.
  • Comfortable working in a large-scale event environment.
  • Able to follow post orders and the established chain of command.
  • Experienced with crowd management, access control, event security, or similar assignments.

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Guard (Level II)
Location: Grapevine
Pay: $18-$20 per hour, depending on qualifications (paid weekly)
Status: Full-time & Part-time

Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage check-in/out residents and visitors in a climate controlled shack.
  • Monitor entrances, access points, and surveillance systems.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, emergencies, or incidents.
  • Prepare detailed incident and activity reports as required.
  • Remain alert and proactive in identifying and reporting security concerns
  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.


Requirements

  • Must have at least one year of experience unarmed security.
  • Must hold a current Level II Texas Noncommissioned Security License
  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods


Schedule

Full Time position:

  • Sunday: 10p-6a
  • Monday: 10p-6a
  • Tuesday: 10p-6a
  • Wednesday: 10p-6a
  • Thursday: 10p-6a
  • Friday: OFF
  • Saturday: OFF


Part Time position:

  • Saturday 2p-10p
  • Sunday 2p-10p


Uniform & Equipment

  • FRPS Provides: Uniform shirt, hats, cold weather gear
  • Officer Provides: Duty pants, black boots


Compensation & Advancement

  • Hourly Pay: $18-$20/hour (based on experience and availability)
  • Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Status: W2 employee (eligible for overtime after 40 hours in a workweek)
  • Shifts: 8 hours per day


Full-Time Employee Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO):
    • 1st Year: Accrue up to 7 days (56 hours)
    • 2nd Year: Accrue up to 10 days (80 hours)
    • 5th Year and beyond: Accrue up to 15 days (120 hours)
  • Health Insurance:
    • Company pays up to $300/month toward employee’s health insurance
    • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage (eligible after first month)
  • Retirement:
    • 401(k) plan with up to 4% company match

jobs.company: D F W Security Protective Force LLC
jobs.description:
About the position

DFW Protective Security Force (DFWPSF) is one of the nation's largest privately held security companies, providing a range of security services for commercial high rises, residential communities, manufacturing facilities, government buildings, banks, and more. We believe that people come first, and that investing in our employees is one of the most important aspects of business. And now we want you to join our team.

Responsibilities

  • Trained and qualified to work multiple posts, in case of call-offs or vacations.
  • Patrols, periodically, buildings and grounds of industrial plant or commercial establishment, docks, logging camp area, or work site.
  • Patrols lobbies, corridors, and public rooms confers with management, interviews guests and employees, and interrogates persons to detect infringements and investigate disturbances, complaints, thefts, vandalisms, and accidents.
  • Patrols public areas to detect fires, unsafe conditions, and missing or inoperative safety equipment.
  • Examines doors, windows, and gates to determine that they are secure.
  • Performs and sets thermostatic controls to maintain specified temperature in buildings or cold storage rooms.
  • Registers at watch stations to record time of inspection trips.
  • Inspects assigned areas and records data such as property damage, unusual occurrences, and malfunctioning of machinery or equipment, for use of supervisory staff.
  • Watches for and reports irregularities such as fire hazards, leaking water pipes, and security doors left unlocked.
  • Warns violators of rule infractions, such as loitering, smoking, or carrying forbidden articles, and apprehends or expels persons engaging in suspicious or criminal acts.
  • Notifies staff of presence of persons with questionable reputations.
  • Permits authorized persons and regulate vehicle/pedestrian traffic at plant entrance to maintain orderly flow.
  • Drives radio equipped car to through client's establishment, check alarms and locates sources of alarm.
  • Sounds alarm or calls police or fire department by telephone in case of fire or presence of unauthorized persons.
  • Assists management and enforcement officers in emergency situations.
  • Apprehends unauthorized persons found on property, using armed force if necessary, and releases them to custody of authorities.
  • Contacts supervisor by radio or telephone to report irregularities and obtain further instructions.
  • Writes investigation and automobile usage reports.

Requirements

  • US Citizen or Legal Resident
  • 21 years of age or older
  • Current Level III with the State of TX (non-commissioned/unarmed)
  • Pass a drug/alcohol test
  • Pass Medical Exam
  • Must have valid TX DL or TX ID
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Proficient in English and pass a reading test with minimum 9th grade comprehension
  • Computer literate
  • Criminal Background check will be conducted and no final or pending Felony charges/convictions, crime of violence, or serious misdemeanor (nothing greater than a class C misdemeanor) will disqualify applicant from working on this contract
  • State issued, Level 3 License - Current and Valid in TOPS
  • State Issued License

Nice-to-haves

  • 1 year of armed and/or unarmed security experience is preferred
  • Have assigned Metro Card for official use only

jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Description
Salary: $18 hourly

Job Title: Level 2 Security Guard (Unarmed)

Location: Fort Worth, TX

Company: Zona Facta Collective

Compensation: $18/hour | Bi-weekly via Direct Deposit

Job Type: Full-Time (Part-Time Weekend Shifts Available)


Position Summary:

Zona Facta Collective is seeking qualified Level 2 Security Officers to join our team for unarmed security positions in Fort Worth, TX. This role includes manning fixed-site security checkpoints and conducting roving vehicle patrols. Officers are responsible for ensuring the safety and security of all personnel on-site. Effective communication skills and experience in conflict resolution are essential to succeed in this role.


Candidates must be capable of writing clear and professional daily reports. This position requires availability for 2nd or 3rd shifts (including overnights), with a typical schedule of five 8-hour shifts per week. Overtime may be required on occasion to cover emergency absences.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and secure assigned site(s) through fixed post and mobile patrols
  • Maintain a visible presence to deter unauthorized activity
  • Communicate effectively with personnel, visitors, and law enforcement as needed
  • Respond calmly and professionally to conflicts or emergencies
  • Complete thorough and accurate daily written incident reports



Requirements:


  • Valid Texas Level 2 Security License (must be in hand)
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check and drug screening
  • Reliable transportation and a valid drivers license with a clean driving record
  • Personal equipment, including black duty pants, black boots, flashlight, etc.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Availability to work evenings, overnights, and occasional weekend overtime

Uniform Details:


  • Company-issued shirt provided by Zona Facta Collective
  • Officers must supply their own black pants and black boots


Compensation & Schedule:


  • $18/hour, paid bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Full-time positions available
  • Limited part-time weekend shifts also available (please indicate interest in your application)



About Zona Facta Collective:

Zona Facta Collective is a team of former law enforcement and military professionals dedicated to providing exceptional private security services. We prioritize the well-being and professionalism of our officers through strong leadership and unwavering support. We believe quality starts with people and were committed to taking care of ours.


To Apply:

Please submit your resume and indicate whether you are applying for a full-time or part-time position.


Thank you,

Zona Facta Collective Leadership
